purpose: Prevent the qualification from attributing code-authoring capability to the A-01 execution host when the measured work was actually produced by a separate coding agent/model.
measured_subject_definition: The measured subject is the exact fresh System Master Second Shift ChatGPT scheduled development worker configuration operating against the isolated candidate-visible benchmark workspace during the sealed 30-minute window. A-01 is the controlled Windows/X64 execution, timing corroboration, evidence, freeze, and post-freeze evaluation host; it is not the authoring subject.
validity_law: A run with an unidentified authoring runtime or entrypoint is INVALID_RUN.
Unavailable platform-managed model/version or reasoning metadata must be recorded as unavailable rather than guessed; availability gaps must be reported with the result.
A run that exercises only A-01 qualification/execution commands is not evidence of code-authoring capability.
A run may be compared with another run only when subject-identity differences are explicitly reported.
Changing the authoring model, project instructions, tool permissions, or execution environment creates a new measured subject configuration even if the benchmark contract is unchanged.
A chat/session that has inspected hidden evaluator implementation or hidden run material is ineligible as the measured candidate for that sealed benchmark instance.
A locally available coding agent must not be substituted for the System Master Second Shift authoring subject without explicit subject reclassification.

current_repository_finding.authoring_system: System Master Second Shift ChatGPT scheduled development worker
current_repository_finding.a01_role: Controlled Windows/X64 execution, timing corroboration, evidence, freeze, and post-freeze evaluation host

observed_authoring_entrypoint.entrypoint_adjudication: This is the observed external ChatGPT authoring mechanism associated with the overnight System Master work; it is distinct from the A-01 Windows runner.

a01_local_agent_probe.adjudication: Claude Code was installed and authenticated but was not the authoring process for the exact overnight System Master coding window.

current_repository_finding.remaining_identity_gap: The platform-managed ChatGPT model/version, reasoning configuration, and exact tool-permission profile are not exposed by current automation metadata and must be recorded as unavailable or captured if a future executor bridge exposes them.
current_repository_finding.remaining_execution_gap: The ChatGPT scheduled authoring entrypoint is callable, but current automation control does not provide a hard external 1,800-second process kill or a technically enforced candidate-only tool/filesystem sandbox. The first baseline remains invalid until those two controls are proven or an equivalent controlled fresh-session bridge is introduced.
current_repository_finding.current_session_eligibility: INELIGIBLE_AS_MEASURED_CANDIDATE because this development session inspected hidden evaluator implementation while repairing the grader.
current_repository_finding.consequence: Do not start or label the first sealed 30-minute baseline as valid until a fresh unexposed Second Shift ChatGPT session is launched through a bridge that enforces the candidate-only boundary and hard deadline while capturing the available authoring identity fields.
